title: WORLDVALUESBENCH: A Large-Scale Benchmark Dataset for Multi-Cultural Value Awareness of Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the ability of language models to predict human answers to questions about religious values, conditioned on demographics. The evaluation metric is the Wasserstein 1-distance between the model's predicted answer distribution and the ground truth human answer distribution.
findings: Larger models, specifically GPT-3.5 Turbo and Mixtral-8x7B, are more capable of conditioning on demographic attributes to predict human responses to questions about religious values. When prompted with demographics, GPT-3.5 Turbo achieved a perfect Wasserstein 1-distance score of 0.00 on two out of the three religious value questions (Q165, Q166), indicating a near-perfect alignment with the human answer distributions for those specific questions.
